description: Discogs #211: independent editorial A 2/10 (2022 Korean FEARLESS EP and 2023 Japanese FEARLESS Single both already correctly typed), B 10/10 negative or candidate exact-edition pairs, C 2/10 negatives (Stray Kids existing EP and ENHYPEN repackage as Release inside an existing MB group), total 14/30; zero automatic type corrections, new unlinked B Verified matches, C recoveries, or measured UI gains.

cases.label: LE SSERAFIM · FEARLESS (debut EP)
cases.review_notes: Official SOURCE MUSIC’s FEARLESS pre-order notice (13 April 2022) explicitly calls the 2 May 2022 LE SSERAFIM debut a 1st Mini Album and documents two separate physical CD variants (Vol.1 and Vol.2). The independent SOURCE MUSIC discography confirms the five-song first mini album and its track sequence. The public exact-ID MusicBrainz→Discogs typed Master matrix #43120411787 independently observed MusicBrainz ReleaseGroup fb426d76 as primary type EP with Discogs Master 2653076; Discogs Release 23314901 is one five-track physical CD version and is directly linked to the exact MB Release cd7fa327 in the matrix. Therefore the ReleaseGroup EP classification already agrees with the label, and Discogs supplies NO new correction or missing type here. The observed pair is retained as Candidate for this corpus type review because no separate physical packaging/pressing adjudication or Android UI measurement was made: candidate is not a Verified unlinked match, app_type Unknown / visible false are unmeasured, and canonical MusicBrainz classification was not rewritten. This A review is independent of previously reviewed B-07, which compared a different MusicBrainz Release against the same Discogs physical edition to test exact pressing identity.

cases.label: LE SSERAFIM · FEARLESS (Japanese debut Single, 2023)
cases.review_notes: The official Universal Music Japan 25 November 2022 announcement explicitly identifies the 25 January 2023 FEARLESS product as LE SSERAFIM's first JAPAN Single, with three songs: FEARLESS -Japanese ver.-, Blue Flame -Japanese ver.- and Choices, plus distinct physical packages/catalogue numbers (UPCH-89511, UPCH-89512, UPCH-89513, etc.). This is a DIFFERENT ReleaseGroup c54392ad from the South Korean 2 May 2022 debut mini-album FEARLESS, group fb426d76 already reviewed separately as A-01 EP. Public CI #43135307603 rechecked MusicBrainz ReleaseGroup c54392ad as primary type Single, MusicBrainz Artist→Discogs Artist 11171795, ReleaseGroup→Discogs Master 2986856, and exact Official MB Release 49f40a51→Discogs Release 26168966 direct relation with same Discogs Master and correct artist ID. The type agrees with independent editorial sources: Single/Single; no Discogs correction. Exact package and press verification, full app display type and visual presence were NOT adjudicated, so match_state remains candidate, app_type Unknown and visible false are unmeasured, never evidence of a rendering failure. The corpus records neither a new unlinked Verified pair nor source-only recovery.

cases.label: ENHYPEN · MEMORABILIA
cases.selection_note: 6/6 track titles but country contradiction and nonidentical barcode; exact edition unresolved
cases.review_notes: BELIFT LAB officially announced a South Korean physical CD product called DARK MOON SPECIAL ALBUM MEMORABILIA (Moon ver.) released 13 May 2024. The exact MB Release d0c0cfe6 is a Japanese Digital Media EP (2024-05-13, barcode 00602465697520); Discogs Release 31008160 in the 11 November live control is a South Korean CD with the same six ordered songs and no independently matching barcode, and its title is expanded to Dark Moon Special Album. This is NOT the same exact MB edition: country/format explicitly disagree despite matching artist, date and tracks. The independently official label calls it a special album, not an explicit EP; reference_type remains Unknown, so no claim to correct MusicBrainz EP is justified. Another MB Release in the same EP group was inspected but lacked pressing identifiers; do not promote it. Android UI was not tested, so app_type Unknown and visible false are NOT a measured rendering failure.

cases.label: TXT · Setsuna Hanabi
cases.selection_note: 4/4 tracks in MB alternative 91c4d2eb; official Universal lists HYBJ-02085 / POCS-30033 CD; missing direct Release link/barcode; pressing unconfirmed
cases.review_notes: Independent Universal Music Japan announcement of 23 July 2026 confirms a physical CD single dated 19 August, four ordered tracks and catalog HYBJ-02085 / POCS-30033. MusicBrainz Release 6770b265 is the distinct 17 August DIGITAL edition of the already existing Single ReleaseGroup cb79234e; the four-title group overlap does not establish identical edition, especially without a same barcode or an exact Release-to-Discogs link. Discogs Release 38302455 was source-observed as a physical-edition lead in prior authenticated-free CI. This B-02 pair is therefore NOT VERIFIED as an exact edition and must not be promoted or counted as a recovered release. The separately observed MusicBrainz physical alternative 91c4d2eb also remains unproven as an identical pressing. App presentation and device UI were not checked; app_type=Unknown and visible=false mean no confirmed UI gain, not a measured absence from rendered shelves.

cases.label: IVE · Fashion
cases.selection_note: different Japanese bilingual title, 0/1 literal track title; edition unresolved
cases.review_notes: Sony Music Japan officially announced the IVE one-track digital song Fashion on 3 April 2026 as the pre-release track for the LUCID DREAM EP; the Apple Music release explicitly presents Fashion - Single dated 3 April with one track. MB Release f9ec060a belongs to a MusicBrainz Single group with exactly one track. Discogs Release 37253067 is a 2026 File Single titled Fashion / ファッション with one observed track, but the exact title and sole track are bilingual and do not literally match MusicBrainz, and no shared validated barcode or direct MB Release-to-Discogs URL was observed in the 11 November CI. Artist IDs match at the provider level, but no independent recording/edition identity proof exists. This is a source-confirmed already-known single, NOT a newly recovered group nor a Verified exact Release correspondence. Keep candidate; do not guess Japanese translation or invent an MBID. App UI not independently checked: Unknown/false fields represent no demonstrated gain, not a failed rendering.

cases.label: IVE · DARE ME
cases.selection_note: different Japanese bilingual title, 0/1 literal track title; edition unresolved
cases.review_notes: Sony Music Japan's official 21 April 2025 notice identifies IVE DARE ME as a new Japanese original digital single and the opening theme of a television drama. MB Release 5df7296a belongs to a Single ReleaseGroup with a one-track digital edition already present. Discogs Release 34121731 is a File Single whose observed title Dare Me / デアミー and lone track differ in text from the MusicBrainz names. The public 11 November exact-ID control confirmed the artist source identities and release year, but no common independently validated barcode, complete literal title match, or direct Release URL relation was observed. Therefore candidate NOT VERIFIED is the only justified exact-edition outcome. This is NOT an absent MusicBrainz group and not evidence of type correction; app UI was not measured, and no new playable audio or MusicBrainz identity is created.

cases.label: TXT · 7TH YEAR CD
cases.selection_note: BIGHIT MUSIC / BHE0779 label+catalog confirmed in MB edition 562a42ed and Discogs; retailer confirms MB UPC; cross-provider barcode differs, 4/6 literal tracks; pressing unconfirmed
cases.review_notes: BIGHIT MUSIC's official TXT release and preorder notice explicitly calls 7TH YEAR the 8th mini album, dated 13 April 2026, with several physical variants. The exact MusicBrainz CD Release 562a42ed belongs to EP ReleaseGroup dc4cfe5f, barcode 8800357999260, BIGHIT MUSIC catalog BHE0779, six tracks; Korean retail catalog independently confirms that UPC and catno. The Discogs Release 37110012 has the same label/catalog number as the MB edition but a DIFFERENT observed barcode and only four of six literal track names matched in prior CI. No direct MusicBrainz Release URL relationship exists to this Discogs Release. Same product family / editorial EP type is supported, but the exact pressing identity is NOT VERIFIED; mark as conflict of exact edition identity, not successful unlinked match or Album correction. App UI and shelf visibility have not been independently checked, so app_type=Unknown / visible=false mean no verified user-visible gain.

cases.label: ENHYPEN · BORDER : DAY ONE CD
cases.selection_note: same reported UPC but 4/6 literal tracks and BELIFT LAB catalog L200001786 vs CMCD 11590; variant unresolved
cases.review_notes: BELIFT LAB's official album discography identifies BORDER : DAY ONE as ENHYPEN's first mini album, with six tracks and DAWN/DUSK visual versions; the official Weverse shop also explicitly lists separate DAWN and DUSK CD package versions. The public 11 November cross-provider matrix found a MusicBrainz official CD Release 6ca81526 (in EP ReleaseGroup 849d8582) and Discogs CD Release 16620135 (Master 1887999) with matching reported barcode digits and year/country compatibility. However, only four of six track titles match literally; more importantly, although both assert the label BELIFT LAB, MusicBrainz reports catalog L200001786 while Discogs reports CMCD 11590. These numbers may reflect different identifiers or variants; no direct MB Release-to-Discogs Release relation was observed. The alternate Discogs CD 16620078 is another plausible competitor. Exact physical pressing is NOT VERIFIED, and same group or UPC does not identify one package. App UI was not checked; Unknown and false visible mean no demonstrated display gain, not a measured missing shelf.

cases.label: LE SSERAFIM · FEARLESS CD
cases.selection_note: 5/5 literal tracks and reported UPC coincide, but source country/year disagree and Discogs ID is directly linked to another MB Release
cases.review_notes: SOURCE MUSIC's official Weverse pre-order announcement confirms FEARLESS as LE SSERAFIM's first mini album, released 2 May 2022, with at least two separate physical CD packages, Vol.1 and Vol.2. The complete public Master matrix (five Discogs versions against nine MusicBrainz Official editions in ReleaseGroup fb426d76) observed a MusicBrainz Release cf60fbce with no direct URL relation to Discogs Release 23314901; both had five literally matching ordered tracks and the same reported barcode digits. However, this pair disagrees on source country AND year, and the same Discogs ID 23314901 has an exact typed direct relation from the DIFFERENT MusicBrainz CD Release cd7fa327-4886-4774-845a-5672596113ca. That independently anchored identity cannot be overwritten by content similarity. The reviewed cross-provider pair is a CONFLICT for exact pressing verification, not a newly recovered edition or new MusicBrainz group. UI presentation and local playback were not measured; app_type Unknown and visible false do not claim an observed rendering defect.

cases.label: IVE · ELEVEN original digital vs physical CD
cases.selection_note: same reported barcode but MusicBrainz Digital Media one-track edition versus Discogs two-track CD; exact edition conflict
cases.review_notes: STARSHIP Entertainment's official 1 December 2021 release notice identifies IVE's debut ELEVEN as its first Single Album. The IVE Japan official discography independently lists both tracks ELEVEN and Take It and multiple physical-package variants. In the complete anonymous 11 November control for typed ReleaseGroup 18271616→Discogs Master 2531575, exact MusicBrainz Release 47106725 is Digital Media with one observed Track, while Discogs Release 21255514 is a physical CD with two observed tracks. Although the providers report matching barcode digits, year and country compatibility, the physical media family and complete track count differ; their editions are NOT identical. The public matrix observes no direct Release→Discogs URL for this MB edition. This is an independently source-reviewed negative exact-edition pair, not a newly recovered title, missing MusicBrainz group, or classification correction. No Android device check was done, so app_type Unknown and visible false do not claim a UI failure.

cases.label: IVE · ELEVEN -Japanese ver.- I CD vs V CD+Blu-ray
cases.selection_note: Sony official I CD KSCL-3390 versus V CD+Blu-ray KSCL-3392; reported barcode differs, 1/2 literal tracks; distinct packaging
cases.review_notes: Sony Music Japan's official Japanese debut announcement and IVE Japan discography identify ELEVEN -Japanese ver.- as a two-song single issued 19 October 2022 in distinct versions: I edition CD+photo book catalog KSCL-3390/3391, V edition CD+Blu-ray catalog KSCL-3392/3393, plus E and Fan Club packages. The anonymous typed Master matrix observed MusicBrainz official CD Release 251ad807 with label Ki/oon catalog KSCL-3390 and Discogs Release 25759165 with Ki/oon catalog KSCL-3392, CD+Blu-ray. Barcode does not match and only one of two track titles matches literally. The official version-specific catalog and physical package distinctions corroborate that this specific pair is NOT one identical pressing, despite being the same single family. No MB Release→Discogs Release direct link was observed for this pair; no MusicBrainz ID, audio, or shelf gain was created. app_type and visible are unmeasured Android placeholders, not tested UI failures.

cases.label: IVE · ELEVEN -Japanese ver.- E CD lead
cases.selection_note: Sony official E edition KSCL-3394; MB Ki/oon KSCL-3394 vs Discogs KSCL 3394, matching UPC but only 1/2 literal tracks; not Verified
cases.review_notes: IVE Japan's official discography specifies that the E normal CD edition of ELEVEN -Japanese ver.-, released on 19 October 2022, is catalog KSCL-3394 and contains two tracks: ELEVEN -Japanese ver.- and Queen of Hearts. The bounded public MusicBrainz ReleaseGroup 07fb58fa→Discogs Master 2911144 inspection observed MusicBrainz official CD Release b9290e0d and Discogs physical CD Release 25524349 with the same reported valid barcode and year/country compatibility. Ki/oon label catalog in MB is KSCL-3394 and Discogs renders KSCL 3394 (punctuation/whitespace variation), so the pair plausibly refers to E, but only one of two titles matches literally; neither provider exposes a direct exact MB Release→Discogs Release URL in the sampled payload. A catalog typography difference is not a substantive variant conflict, but neither the UPC alone nor a shared two-track product family proves edition identity. Retain as Candidate, not Verified or recovered Release. Android UI and playback were not checked; Unknown/false fields are no demonstrated gain, not a measured absence.

cases.label: Stray Kids · Social Path / Super Bowl -Japanese ver.-
cases.selection_note: Discogs title-index zero hit from variant Superbowl, but official Sony and exact MusicBrainz artist EP ReleaseGroup show existing 2023 EP; no C absence proof
cases.review_notes: Official Sony Music Japan's 27 July 2023 announcement explicitly identifies Social Path (feat. LiSA) / Super Bowl -Japanese ver.- as Stray Kids JAPAN 1st EP, issued 6 September 2023 with five common audio tracks. MusicBrainz already contains exact Stray Kids ReleaseGroup e248dce6-bef8-4d1f-a6d8-164de112151f classified EP, with a five-track official digital Release. Public anonymous CI #43118510232 independently hydrated Discogs Release 38526540 as a solo Stray Kids artist-linked File source candidate titled Social Path / Superbowl (Japanese Ver.) without a reported barcode, and its initial exact title-index lookup returned zero. That zero is a query/title-normalization false negative, NOT proof of missing catalog content. The Discogs edition cannot be equated to an exact MusicBrainz physical pressing without source relations, barcodes or a complete pair comparison. Thus reviewed for known-release non-absence only: no new MusicBrainz group, no Verified edition, no UI recovery, and no observed missing EP in BitChord. app_type Unknown and visible false reflect no device measurement.

cases.label: ENHYPEN · ROMANCE : UNTOLD -daydream- (repackage already in MusicBrainz)
cases.review_notes: The BELIFT LAB official discography explicitly identifies ENHYPEN ROMANCE : UNTOLD -daydream- as a 2nd Studio Repackage Album, released 11 November 2024, with two new songs and the remaining tracks from the second album. The public Discogs C follow-up CI #43124506344 observed Release 32437206 with correct exact Discogs artist ID 8303009, but its barcode lookup was unavailable and never proved source absence. Independent MusicBrainz Release 4c42b226 is an Official 2024 South Korean CD with the same daydream repackage title and 11-song tracklist, stored in ReleaseGroup 0c668bdb, whose canonical group title is ROMANCE : UNTOLD (Album). Therefore MusicBrainz ALREADY HAS a repackage edition even though ReleaseGroup title alone does not contain -daydream-. This is a C negative, not a new Discogs-only recovery or evidence of false MB artist relations. Source Discogs 32437206 and the MB physical pressing have not been confirmed identical by label/catalog/packaging, hence candidate, not Verified. App_type Unknown and visible false represent not measured on Android, not observed rendering failure; MusicBrainz ReleaseGroup and types remain unchanged.
